comment: Icon manifest. SVGs in ./svg are the exact bytes exported from Figma —
never redrawn by hand. scripts/build-icons.mjs turns them into React
components in ./generated.tsx with every fill/stroke rewritten to
currentColor, so an icon inherits colour from its container.
`viewBox` is the composed coordinate space. Single-part icons use the
exported SVG's own viewBox, which preserves the designed aspect ratio —
several of these are deliberately NOT square (chevron is 9.99x5.49, layers
is 22.65x26.18, logo-beta is 21.45x33.87). Do not normalise them.
Figma wraps each icon in a padded outer box (31/32px) with the artwork
inset ~11.46%. That padding is dropped here: components render the leaf,
Offsets on multi-part icons are derived from the Figma insets, e.g. the
folder body sits at 14.58% left / 18.75% top of a 32px box, expanded by
the stroke bleed Figma reports as a negative inner inset.
